description: Boulder County publishes a line inventory of culverts. The linked layer covers county-owned roads and Parks and Open Space properties, which is broader than the road-only scope described in the DCAT feed. Public Works and Parks and Open Space maintain the inventory. The schema defines culvert shape and material, wall types, width and height in inches, barrel count, load rating, road location, ownership and maintenance. These attributes can support culvert and drainage simulation, subject to checking hydraulic boundary conditions and geometry. The feed says replaced assets are retained; the active-versus-archived distinction must be checked before treating all records as operating infrastructure. No feature values were inspected. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue. The county overview has inconsistent licence wording; this record preserves the explicit layer-feed licence URL.
